listing.name: FIFA 09 (Xbox 360) — FIFA 09 PC (ChunchunQ)
listing.summary: Upstream describes release and online features. Support for every game mode is unknown. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own FIFA 09 (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 4541085B; this guide does not include the XEX SHA-256. Use only the project’s required region and title update; other regions or updates are unsafe for this port.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the Windows ZIP, place files from your own FIFA 09 disc in Game, then start the launcher. Only the XEX documented by upstream is supported.

warnings: Upstream describes release and online features. Support for every game mode is unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
